lines.raw: In lesson 3 you saw that Original Medicare leaves **gaps**: deductibles, 20% coinsurance and no yearly limit.
lines.say: In lesson 3 you saw that Original Medicare leaves gaps: deductibles, 20 percent coinsurance and no yearly limit.

lines.raw: **Medigap** (also called **Medicare Supplement Insurance**) is a private policy that pays some or all of those gaps.
lines.say: Medigap (also called Medicare Supplement Insurance) is a private policy that pays some or all of those gaps.

lines.raw: In the US: How Medigap works.
lines.say: In the U S: How Medigap works.

lines.raw: Medigap works **only with Original Medicare**.
lines.say: Medigap works only with Original Medicare.

lines.raw: Medicare pays its share first, then Medigap pays some or all of what is left.
lines.say: Medicare pays its share first, then Medigap pays some or all of what is left.

lines.raw: Policies are **standardised** and named with letters, such as **Plan G** or **Plan N**.
lines.say: Policies are standardised and named with letters, such as Plan G or Plan N.

lines.raw: A Plan G from one insurer covers the same things as a Plan G from another; only the price differs.
lines.say: A Plan G from one insurer covers the same things as a Plan G from another; only the price differs.

lines.raw: Plans C and F (which also paid the Part B deductible) cannot be bought by people who became eligible for Medicare on or after **1 January 2020**.
lines.say: Plans C and F (which also paid the Part B deductible) cannot be bought by people who became eligible for Medicare on or after 1 January 2020.

lines.raw: Plan G is a common choice today.
lines.say: Plan G is a common choice today.

lines.raw: The person pays a separate monthly **premium** to the Medigap insurer, on top of the Part B premium.
lines.say: The person pays a separate monthly premium to the Medigap insurer, on top of the Part B premium.

lines.raw: The best time to buy is the **6-month Medigap open enrollment** that starts when someone is 65 and has Part B.
lines.say: The best time to buy is the 6-month Medigap open enrollment that starts when someone is 65 and has Part B.

lines.raw: During it, insurers cannot refuse them or charge more for health problems.

lines.raw: Key takeaways.

lines.raw: Medigap (Medicare Supplement) is a private policy that fills gaps in Original Medicare, such as the 20% coinsurance.

lines.raw: Policies are standardised by letter, like Plan G: same letter, same benefits; insurers compete on price.
